unit: price per token, in the table's currency
source: API list prices read on 2026-11-03 from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (gpt-6.1-sol, Standard processing, short-context tier: prompts up to 272K tokens) and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5; cache_write is the five-minute cache write rate, cache_read the cache hit rate). OpenAI lists no cache-write price, so gpt-6.1-sol has cache_write 0. Two models are priced by prompt length and are entered at the lower tier only (gpt-6.1-sol up to 272K tokens, claude-haiku-5-5 up to 100K tokens), so a cost derived from the table is a lower bound for longer prompts. A cost from this table is an API list-price equivalent, not what a subscription charges. A model absent from the table, and an alias such as opus, sonnet or haiku, gives cost null and quality unknown
